responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend AST dumping interface: the `Indent` helper and the `AST::Dump` visitor class that provides crate/item entry points, debug helpers, collection-formatting utilities, and a large set of `visit` overloads covering the full Rust AST. This header defines the public shape of the source-level AST printer used for debugging and inspection, distinguishing it from the AST class headers by specifying traversal and formatting behavior rather than node storage.
same_name_distinction: Declares the dumping API shared by the printer implementation in rust-ast-dump.cc: the `Indent` helper and the `AST::Dump` visitor class with its large set of `visit` overloads and traversal helpers. Unlike the `.cc` file, it provides the type/interface surface for AST dumping, not the emitted-text implementations.
